title: Exchanges at the Northbeam Returns and Restocking Desk: What the Terms Provide
content:
*An exchange is offered only on the schedules that allow it and only inside the schedule's exchange window, counted from the same anchor as the return window.* That clause is **no longer in force**, superseded for Northbeam Returns and Restocking by the current basis on which an exchange window is counted. *A price difference is settled as the schedule's difference basis names: where today's shelf price is higher the customer pays the difference, where it is lower the difference is returned by the refund method* — that clause is likewise **no longer in force**, superseded by the current basis on which a difference is settled — and on a like-for-like schedule no difference is settled at all. An exchange item is issued only once the returned item has been received and graded at a grade the schedule refunds in full; a customer who wants an exchange on a customer-damaged item is offered the reduced refund instead. Where the exchange is delivered and the schedule takes the old item away, the haul-away is booked with the delivery and is not charged. A protection plan on the item exchanged is moved to the new serial at no fee, and the plan's term is not restarted.

## The terms in force, put as conditions

| Condition | What the terms provide |
| --- | --- |
| the schedule settles an exchange like for like | no difference is settled at all |
| the returned item has been received and graded at a grade the schedule refunds in full | an exchange item is issued |
| the item is graded as damaged by the customer | the reduced refund is offered instead of an exchange |
| the exchange is delivered and the schedule takes the old item away | the haul-away is booked with the delivery, and is not charged |
| a protection plan stands on the item exchanged | the plan is moved to the new serial at no fee, and its term is not restarted |

## Questions the terms answer

**Is a grade that the schedule refunds only in part enough for an exchange?** No. The exchange item is issued only on a grade the schedule refunds in full. A customer holding an item graded as damaged by the customer is offered the reduced refund instead.

**Does moving a protection plan to the replacement cost the customer anything, or buy them more term?** Neither. The plan moves to the new serial at no fee, and its term is not restarted.

**Is the haul-away of the old item a charge on the exchange?** No. Where the schedule takes the old item away, the haul-away is booked with the delivery of the replacement and is not charged.
